pull_request.title: Add retry budgets and a dead-letter queue
pull_request.breaking_change: Store implementations must add Reset(ctx, id) and return ErrNotRunning from Ack for a job that is not running.

tiles.headline: Jobs that fail now back off exponentially and stop after a bounded number of attempts

ranked.text: RoleFromRequest trusts X-Taskline-Role, so any caller that reaches the service without the gateway can claim the operator role and read or requeue dead letters
All workers share one policy, so a burst of failures retries in step; 20 percent jitter may not spread the retries enough to protect a recovering dependency
The handler documents newest first, but the in-memory List walks a map and returns entries in no defined order
ON DELETE CASCADE removes a dead-letter row when its job is deleted, so pruning old jobs also erases their failure history

tiles.title: Operator-only dead-letter endpoints
tiles.headline: Adds GET /v1/dead-letters and POST /v1/dead-letters/{id}/requeue behind a RequireOperator wrapper that reads the caller's role from a request header
tiles.summary: Adds GET /v1/dead-letters and POST /v1/dead-letters/{id}/requeue behind a RequireOperator wrapper that reads the caller's role from a request header.
tiles.attention: The operator role comes from a header the client can send; the endpoints are only as safe as the gateway in front of them.
missing_evidence: failed: The linter accepts the new handlers

tiles.title: Retry policy and backoff
tiles.headline: Adds RetryPolicy with exponential backoff, a delay cap, jitter and a total attempt budget, and makes Worker use it in place of a fixed delay
tiles.summary: Adds RetryPolicy with exponential backoff, a delay cap, jitter and a total attempt budget, and makes Worker use it in place of a fixed delay.
tiles.attention: Backoff and jitter are covered only by unit tests, and nothing exercises many workers retrying together.
missing_evidence: missing: Workers retrying one failing handler together stay spread out

tiles.title: Dead-letter store and migration
tiles.headline: Adds a dead-letter set for jobs that exhaust their retry budget, a migration with the dead_letters table, and Store.Reset so a buried job can be requeued with…
tiles.summary: Adds a dead-letter set for jobs that exhaust their retry budget, a migration with the dead_letters table, and Store.Reset so a buried job can be requeued with a fresh attempt count.
tiles.attention: The migration cascades deletes from jobs, and Requeue calls into the store while holding its own lock.

tiles.title: Second ack is ignored
tiles.headline: Fixes a race where two workers acknowledging the same job both marked it done: Ack now fails with ErrNotRunning unless the job is running, and the worker treat…
tiles.summary: Fixes a race where two workers acknowledging the same job both marked it done: Ack now fails with ErrNotRunning unless the job is running, and the worker treats that error as already handled.
